name: Omni Sweet Potato & Quinoa Loaf (wet, tin)
note: Omni plant-based, grain-free complete wet food (sweet potato, quinoa, lupin beans, chicory root). Label (as fed): moisture 74%, protein 8.5%, fat 3.5%, fibre 2%, inorganic matter (ash) 3%. Ca, P, Na, K, Mg and energy not declared - energy estimated (modified Atwater); ask Omni for phosphorus. Vitamins A, D3, E are the ADDED amounts only (per kg: A 3,500 IU, D3 350 IU, E 35 mg). Trace minerals left blank (AAFCO minimums assumed, complete food); added per kg: Zn 30 mg, Fe 20 mg, Cu 3 mg, Mn 3 mg, I 0.5 mg, Se 0.02 mg - ingredients add more. Also adds taurine 200 mg/kg, methionine 0.02%, L-carnitine 0.01%. Same label figures as Omni Soothing Stew. Source: omni.pet (label, Nov 2026).
